mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over 3 consecutive months signals an easing monetary policy, lowering discount rates and increasing present value of expected equity cash flows, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances despite FEDFUNDS decline, or walk-forward Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the federal funds rate above 4.25% triggers a risk-off reaction, compressing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, which produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
